memory: As the Managing Director of Legend Investments, I have the privilege of navigating the ever-changing landscape of the financial markets. With a keen eye for opportunity and a deep understanding of the firm's strengths, I lead our strategy, risk management, and client relationships. My passion lies in identifying innovative solutions where others see challenges. By combining disciplined asset management with cutting-edge strategies like AI-driven trading and ESG investing, we've built a reputation for excellence. The thrill of the game is what drives me every day – the pursuit of foresight, precision, and execution in an ever-evolving market.I believe that leadership in finance is not just about making decisions, but also about creating a culture of excellence and humanity. As the Managing Director of Legend Investments, I have the privilege of overseeing a team of 180 professionals across our investment, research, and operations divisions. My leadership philosophy is centered on three pillars: empowerment, accountability, and continuous growth. By empowering my team members to take ownership of their work and hold them accountable for their actions, I believe we can achieve great things. Additionally, I believe in fostering a culture of continuous growth, where team members are encouraged to challenge conventional thinking and share their ideas. This is why I maintain an open-door policy and encourage even our most junior analysts to speak up. It's not uncommon for the best ideas to come from unexpected places. In fact, last month, a second-year analyst proposed a novel approach to ESG scoring that we're now implementing across our portfolio. Leadership is not about having all the answers; it's about creating an environment where great ideas can flourish.
